identity.name: Agency
identity.definition: A federal department, agency, or sub-element that publishes job listings.

structure.evidence: name, code, departmentName, agencyLevel, missionSummary, logoUrl, activeListingCount — sufficient for a full detail page.

instances.evidence: Department of Defense; National Park Service; Food and Drug Administration.

purpose.evidence: Job seekers navigate to agencies to browse available positions at organizations they want to work for.

sipValidation.verdict: Valid object. Distinct identity, navigable, and a natural hub for Job Listing discovery.

synonyms.context: Top-level federal organizations, e.g. Department of Defense
synonyms.notes: Department is a specific agencyLevel value, not a synonym for Agency as a whole.

synonyms.context: Sub-elements within an agency, e.g. Bureau of Land Management
synonyms.notes: Bureau is an agencyLevel value. A bureau is an Agency with agencyLevel of sub-element.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full name of the agency, department, or sub-element.

attributes.name: departmentName
attributes.description: The parent department name. Absent when agencyLevel is Department.
attributes.example: Department of Health and Human Services

attributes.name: departmentCode
attributes.description: The OPM department code. Absent when agencyLevel is Department.

attributes.name: subElementName
attributes.description: The bureau or office name within the agency. Present only when agencyLevel is Sub-element.
attributes.example: Center for Drug Evaluation and Research

attributes.name: agencyLevel
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this agency in the federal structure.

attributes.name: missionSummary
attributes.description: A one-paragraph plain-language description of the agency's mission. Manually curated — not available from the API.

attributes.name: websiteUrl
attributes.description: The official agency website. Manually curated.

attributes.name: logoUrl
attributes.description: The agency seal or logo. Manually curated.

attributes.name: activeListingCount
attributes.description: Count of currently open Job Listings for this agency. Computed at query time from the API.

actions.name: Browse agency listings
actions.description: Navigates to a filtered list of open Job Listings for this agency.

actions.name: Follow agency
actions.description: Subscribes to notifications when new listings are posted by this agency.

actions.name: Share agency page
actions.description: Copies or shares a direct URL to the agency page.

relationships.mechanics: Automatic. Job Listings carry the agency code, which maps back to this Agency object.
relationships.cardinality: one-to-many (one Agency has many Job Listings; large agencies may have thousands of active listings)
relationships.sorts: Default: openDate descending. Options: closeDate ascending, grade descending.
relationships.filters: Series, location, grade, appointment type, work schedule, telework eligibility.
relationships.dependencies: Optional for Agency. Agencies can exist with zero active listings. If Agency data is removed, listings retain the agency code but render in degraded state.

relationships.mechanics: Derived. The set of series codes appearing on an agency's active listings determines which series are associated with it.
relationships.cardinality: many-to-many (one Agency hires across many series; one series spans many agencies)
relationships.dependencies: Optional. The relationship dissolves if an agency posts no listings in a given series.

relationships.mechanics: Derived. The set of locations on an agency's active listings determines which locations are associated with it.
relationships.cardinality: one-to-many (one Agency operates in many Locations)
relationships.dependencies: Optional. The relationship dissolves if an agency posts no listings at a given location.

views.context: An Agency in a browse or search context.
views.userIntent: Identify agencies worth exploring for job opportunities.

views.context: An Agency detail page visited by a job seeker.
views.userIntent: Learn about the agency and browse its open listings.

stories.title: Job seeker explores a target agency
stories.benefit: finds relevant open positions at an organization they want to work for
stories.whenClause: When a job seeker knows which agency they want to work for
stories.thenClause: They see the agency's mission, current openings, and a way to follow for future listings

businessRules.title: Hierarchy levels are distinct
businessRules.description: A listing always links to the most specific agency level available. A listing for the FDA links to the FDA (Agency level), not to HHS (Department level).

businessRules.title: Manual attributes may be absent
businessRules.description: missionSummary, websiteUrl, and logoUrl are manually curated. They will not be available for all agencies on launch. The detail page must degrade gracefully when these are absent.

businessRules.title: activeListingCount is live
businessRules.description: activeListingCount is computed from the API at query time. It reflects the current open listing count, not a stored value.

states.name: Active
states.description: The agency is operational and may have open listings.
states.triggers: Agency is added to the data set.

states.name: Inactive
states.description: The agency no longer exists or has been merged into another agency.
states.triggers: Agency is removed from or flagged inactive in OPM data.
